text:
Alex: heads-up: pushed kernel-selection tweak that prefers fused-paged for seq>1024. bench looks good but saw a numeric oddity on a regression run.

Maria: what oddity?

Alex: on a small canary with fp16 + kv cache reuse (mixed batch sizes) we got occasional softmax explode (inf) in attention unit tests.

Sam: repro steps?

Alex: minimal repro in CI: batch of 3 requests, seq lens [128, 2048, 4096], model=gpt-small-8k-128, use_flash=false, kernel_hint=fused_paged

Alex: paste of failing kernel log:
```
[ATTN] kv_cache_merge: merged_kv_size=65536
kernel_executor: selected=fused_paged_variant_3
softmax: preexp max=64.2 -> exp overflow -> INF
```

Kyle: that's huge. softmax preexp max of 64 is suspicious for fp16.

Maria: did the kernel change scaling? recent patch removed an extra rescale before accumulation.

Alex: yep that's the patch. I thought fused_paged had internal stabilization but maybe we removed a safety clamp.

Sam: can we force bf16 for that path in CI to see if numeric diff disappears?

Alex: tried bf16 on the failing job: no infs. So likely fp16 accumulation rounding + missing clamp.

ci-bot: perf/regression job 1724501248 started: run/attn-fuse-kernel-candidate

Kyle: also saw a perf regression in some 64k token streaming workloads after kernel-route change - latency P95 up ~18% on nv4a. different machines show different perf.

Maria: could be batching heuristics: fused_paged interacts poorly with our continuous-batching logic when KV sizes cross a threshold. It might fall back to a slower path or do unexpected memcopies.

Alex: instrumented timeline shows extra memcpy at merge point for the 4k sequence case. nvprof top shows 2 extra kernels: memcpy_kv_in and memcpy_kv_out.

Sam: any chance memcopy size incorrectly computed leading to reading uninitialized memory and then huge logit values?

Alex: grep of code: there is an off-by-one in chunk_count calc when seq%tile==0. patch link: https://git.internal/r/98765

Maria: if that's the bug then it explains both perf hit (extra memcpy) and numeric instability (garbage into softmax). fix should be small.

Kyle: alternative quick mitigation: add softmax pre-clamp: clip x to [-50,50] before exp in fused_paged as guard. cheap and safety-first.

Alex: agree. I'll land two-step: 1) hotfix clamp in fused_paged softmax; 2) revert kernel-selection heuristic until we validate with long seq mixed batches.

Sam: please add a unit test that mixes batch sizes and forces kv cache reuse. Also run on rtci/nv4a and tb3.

Maria: note: if we clamp, perf impact is ~0% on our microbench. Good to ship quickly.

Alex: putting up PRs now: 1724501260-hotfix-clamp-fusedpaged & 1724501265-revert-kernelselector

Kyle: I'll run extended perf sweep overnight with patched binaries. will report numbers in morning.

Maria: thanks. also add a brief note in the console rollout doc: when kernel selection toggles, observability should mark model routes that experienced softmax_infs.

Alex: copied. follow-up: need to audit other kernels for missing pre-rescale. I'll open a tracking issue.

Sam: thumbs. keep thread updated.

Kyle: FYI re-run looks clean w/ clamp. no infs in 2000 mixed-batch runs. perf sweep started.

ci-bot: perf job 1724501330 completed: p95 Δ +1% (within noise) on nv4a after clamp

Maria: good outcome. after Kyle's sweep we can re-enable heuristic gradually behind a feature flag.

Alex: thanks everyone. I'll patch the canary to use clamp and keep an eye on the tracing dashboard.
